intro:
Imagine a game that combines the challenge of a puzzle game with the time pressure of an arcade game, all set in a winter wonderland theme. Welcome to Build a Snowman, a hardcore logical game that will put your brain to the test. At first glance, the game seems simple - merge two parts of a snowman's body to create a new one. But don't be fooled. This game is deceptively difficult, requiring precise timing and strategy to navigate its increasingly complex levels.

In Build a Snowman, you control two parts of the snowman's body simultaneously, using blocks to stop one part and avoid fire, which is deadly to snowmen. As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter locked doors that require keys to unlock, and even portals that will transport you to new locations. The game takes place in three different worlds - winter, green, and Mexican - each with its own unique challenges and obstacles.

What sets Build a Snowman apart from other puzzle games is its addictive gameplay and sense of accomplishment. Each level is carefully designed to provide a sense of satisfaction and progress, making it difficult to put the game down. The game also features 30 hardcore levels, providing a significant challenge for even the most experienced players.

With its simple yet engaging gameplay, Build a Snowman is a must-play for fans of puzzle games and anyone looking for a fun and challenging experience. So, grab some hot cocoa, get cozy by the fire, and get ready to build a snowman like never before.
